tuition.domestic_or_home: $11,200 approx. per year (Wisconsin Residents); $40,600 approx. per year (Non-Wisconsin US Residents)

name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

tuition.domestic_or_home: $9,000 approx. per year (North Carolina In-State Residents); $39,000 approx. per year (US Out-of-State Residents)

IELTS Academic: Minimum 7.0

scholarships.name: Morehead-Cain Scholarship

scholarships.name: Robertson Scholars Leadership Program

tuition.notes: Tuition is identical for domestic and international undergraduates. Total cost of attendance includes mandatory fees, room, and board.

language_tests: TOEFL iBT: Minimum 100
IELTS Academic: Minimum 7.0
Duolingo English Test (DET): Minimum 130
standardized_tests: SAT or ACT (Policy varies, review current institutional submission guidelines)

Counselor recommendation and two teacher recommendations
Financial Statement of Responsibility (for international applicants)

scholarships.name: Trustee Distinguished Scholarships

bachelor.financial_aid_summary: Rice is need-aware for international undergraduate applicants. Financial aid is available to a limited number of international students; international applicants requesting aid must submit the CSS Profile.

language_tests: TOEFL iBT: Required for non-native speakers (Minimum score 100 recommended)
